answer_1.quote: We propose converting long videos ... to "small" coherent textual stories by verbalizing keyframes, audio, and text-overlaid scenes with the help of a powerful LLM ... The generated story captures information across scenes, characters, event sequences, dialogues, emotions, and the environment.
answer_1.outputs: coherent textual stories describing the video content

answer_2.quote: We use several NLP metrics, viz., BLEU-N, ROUGE-L, METEOR and CIDEr to measure the similarity between the story generated by the model and ground truth.
